snapshot.title: Time Jump — 10:00 AM — UAS-02 Still Unresponsive

fields.narration: It is now 10:00 AM on Sunday, October 25, 2026. The UAS-02 aircraft has not been recovered. The GCS-01 telemetry feed shows it remains at 398 ft AGL, not moving, on private property in the Birch Hollow Range. The ASO has confirmed that the flight has exceeded 400 ft AGL and entered Class C airspace. The FSDO has been notified, but no response has been received. The media is beginning to report a 'drone crash near Harwick'. The crew is under pressure to act, and the Systems & Cybersecurity Lead (it) has found a mismatch between the firmware log and the GCS-01 parameter export.
worldState: It is now 10:00 AM on Sunday, October 25, 2026.
UAS-02 remains at 398 ft AGL, not moving, on private property in the Birch Hollow Range.
The aircraft has exceeded 400 ft AGL and entered Class C airspace.
The FAA Harwick FSDO (585-555-0188) has been notified but has not responded.
The local TV station, Channel 10, has aired a brief segment on the incident: 'Unmanned aircraft seen flying over residential area near Harwick; authorities investigating.'
The social media post from @HarwickOpsTrainee (https://huog.example/ops-internal/2026-10-15-0918-crash.mp4) has been shared 1,200 times and is trending with #ClassCIncursion.
The Director of Flight Operations has issued a fleet-wide grounding order; no new flights may commence until further notice.
The Aviation Safety Officer is drafting the NTSB reportable event determination.
The Communications Lead is preparing a holding statement for media inquiries.

The Systems & Cybersecurity Lead has identified a mismatch between the firmware log (2.4.11a) and the GCS-01 parameter export: the 'RTL on link loss' flag is set to 'Disabled' in the export, but the log shows it was not overridden in the firmware update.
